description: A dependency-free sortable list for drag-to-reorder interactions with controlled state and keyboard-friendly move buttons.

intro: SortableList provides a small, dependency-free primitive for reordering application data with native drag events and accessible move controls.

faqs.question: Can I control the order externally?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pass items and update them from onItemsChange to keep the list controlled.

faqs.question: Does it support keyboard users?
faqs.answer: The up and down move buttons provide an accessible keyboard alternative to dragging.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body: Rows use native HTML5 drag events and call onItemsChange whenever an item changes position.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Provide a meaningful label and keep the move buttons enabled for users who do not drag.
